meta.description: Implement scoped backend changes: API routes, service logic, DB queries, auth middleware, migrations. Reads docs/current_task.xml for exact scope.
meta.trigger_phrases: implement backend, write the API, update the service, fix the query, add the endpoint, write the migration, implement auth, build the service

steps.step: Read docs/Purpose.xml, docs/context.xml, docs/current_task.xml. First reply must restate: - Task goal (one sentence) - Files you will modify (exact paths from docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope) - Acceptance criteria you are targeting If any required fact is absent from docs/context.xml — output BLOCKED, stop.

Output implementation plan before writing any code: - Numbered steps - Which existing functions/types you extend vs create - How each error path is handled - Tests you will add If plan requires scope change — stop, await engineer confirmation.

constraints.item: Modify only files in docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope.
No invented endpoints, env vars, DB columns, or type shapes.
No `any` without inline justification comment on the same line.
Validate all user input server-side before DB writes.
Parameterized queries only — no SQL string interpolation.
Every error path returns a typed response. No silent swallows.
No mock/stub code unless labeled: // MOCK — remove before merge
No new dependencies without Orchestrator approval.

steps.step: Write or update tests: - Happy path for changed logic - At least one error/edge case per changed function Run: npm run test -- --testPathPattern=[changed-file] Report actual test output — do not summarize as "tests pass".
End reply with: files_changed: [list] tests_run: [command + actual output] remaining_unknowns: [list or "none"] docs_drift: [stale docs/context.xml fields or "none"]

stop_and_ask.condition: Task requires files outside docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope.
Schema or API contract change needed.

escalation.path: Switch to orchestrator. Surface the exact missing fact or blocker.
Escalate before writing any code. Orchestrator updates docs/ first.
Switch to reviewer. Pass the diff and docs/current_task.xml acceptance criteria.
